title: Username maker
instruction: Make a school username: the user's name in lowercase followed by their year group, for example sarah8. Print it and say how many characters long it is.
hint: Both inputs are already text, so + can glue them together.

blocks.code: year = input("What year group are you in? ")

blanks.hint: Lowercase name, then glue on the year

expectedOutput: What year group are you in? 8
